description: Detector classes for the sharp-object extension. Every class raises the same alert 'CAM VAT SAC NHON'; weapon_class is kept in the event for review. Source labels are mapped here; unmapped labels are dropped.
prelabel_rules: sickle->ma_tau (Vietnamese news show curved 'rua' machetes, not sickles); a box at least 5x longer than wide and spanning >=35% of the image becomes dao_phong_lon; cross-class NMS IoU 0.5; drop boxes >50% or <0.05% of the image
